```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(getwd(), "helpers_workflow.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "inst", "scripts", "helpers_workflow.R"),
  system.file("scripts", "helpers_workflow.R", package = "metpipe")
)
helper_candidates <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)]
if (length(helper_candidates) == 0) stop("Cannot locate helpers_workflow.R")
source(helper_candidates[[1]], local = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, include = TRUE)

```

## Inputs

```{r inputs}

cfg         <- wf_read_yaml_config(params$config, label = "params$config")
path_result <- wf_cfg_required(cfg, "path_result")

overlap_names <- if (!wf_is_blank(params$overlap_by_name)) {
  trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(params$overlap_by_name), ",", fixed = TRUE)))
} else {
  character(0)
}

diag_path <- file.path(path_result, "data", "merge_diagnostics.rds")
if (!file.exists(diag_path))
  stop("Merge diagnostics not found: ", diag_path,
       "\nRun merge_batches before evaluate_merge.")

diag             <- readRDS(diag_path)
all_diag         <- diag$all_diag
all_counts       <- diag$all_counts
all_l2r          <- diag$all_l2r
all_input_counts <- diag$all_input_counts
n_final_per_tbl  <- diag$n_final

if (is.null(all_diag) || nrow(all_diag) == 0)
  stop("No alignment diagnostics found in ", diag_path)

cat("Config:     ", params$config, "\n")
cat("Overlap:    ", length(overlap_names), "samples specified\n")
if (length(overlap_names) > 0)
  cat("  ", paste(overlap_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Table types:", paste(unique(all_diag$table), collapse = ", "), "\n")

```

## Alignment diagnostics

### Feature counts

```{r feature_counts, fig.height=4}

merged_counts <- data.frame(
  table    = names(n_final_per_tbl),
  label    = "merged",
  features = unname(n_final_per_tbl),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

count_plot_df <- rbind(all_input_counts, merged_counts)
input_levels  <- sort(unique(all_input_counts$label))
count_plot_df$label <- factor(count_plot_df$label, levels = c(input_levels, "merged"))

ggplot(count_plot_df, aes(x = label, y = features, fill = label == "merged")) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = features), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "seagreen")) +
  facet_wrap(~table, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Feature counts: input batches vs merged output",
       x = NULL, y = "Features")

knitr::kable(
  all_counts,
  caption = "Per-step feature counts",
  col.names = c("Table", "Step", "Before merge", "Batch features", "After merge")
)

```

### m/z alignment quality

```{r mz_quality, fig.height=4}

ggplot(all_diag, aes(x = mz_ppm)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(table ~ step) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "m/z difference for matched feature pairs",
       x = "m/z difference (ppm)", y = "Features")

```

### RT alignment quality

```{r rt_quality, fig.height=4}

ggplot(all_diag, aes(x = rt_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "darkorange", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(table ~ step) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "RT difference for matched feature pairs",
       x = "|RT difference| (min)", y = "Features")

```

## Overlap sample consistency

```{r overlap_check}

has_overlap_data <- !all(is.na(all_diag$overlap_cor))

if (!has_overlap_data) {
  cat("No shared area columns detected between batches.",
      "Overlap sample consistency cannot be evaluated.\n")
}

```

```{r overlap_cor, eval=has_overlap_data, fig.height=4}

cor_data <- all_diag[!is.na(all_diag$overlap_cor), , drop = FALSE]

ggplot(cor_data, aes(x = overlap_cor)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "seagreen", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  facet_grid(table ~ step) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Overlap sample Spearman correlation per feature (batch A vs batch B)",
       subtitle = "Red dashed line: 0.8 quality threshold",
       x = "Spearman r", y = "Features")

cor_summary <- cor_data |>
  group_by(table, step) |>
  summarise(
    n_features     = n(),
    median_cor     = round(median(overlap_cor, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    pct_cor_gte_09 = round(100 * mean(overlap_cor >= 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_cor_lt_08  = round(100 * mean(overlap_cor < 0.8,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  cor_summary,
  caption = "Overlap sample Spearman correlation summary",
  col.names = c("Table", "Step", "Features", "Median cor",
                "% cor ≥ 0.9", "% cor < 0.8")
)

```

```{r overlap_ratio, eval=has_overlap_data, fig.height=4}

l2r_data <- all_diag[!is.na(all_diag$median_log2ratio), , drop = FALSE]

ggplot(l2r_data, aes(x = median_log2ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "mediumpurple", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  facet_grid(table ~ step) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Median log2 ratio of overlap sample intensities (batch A / batch B)",
       subtitle = "Red dashed lines: ±0.5 threshold (≈1.4× fold change)",
       x = "Median log₂(batch A / batch B)", y = "Features")

```

```{r overlap_density, eval=has_overlap_data && !is.null(all_l2r) && nrow(all_l2r) > 0, fig.height=4}

ggplot(all_l2r, aes(x = log2ratio)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue4") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  facet_grid(table ~ step) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Density of all per-sample overlap log2 ratios",
       subtitle = "Clipped to ±3; ideal distribution is narrow and centred at 0",
       x = "log₂(batch A / batch B)", y = "Density")

```

## Flagged features

```{r flagged}

flagged <- all_diag[
  (!is.na(all_diag$overlap_cor)      & all_diag$overlap_cor < 0.8) |
  (!is.na(all_diag$median_log2ratio) & abs(all_diag$median_log2ratio) > 0.5),
  , drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
  cat("No features flagged: all matched features have overlap_cor ≥ 0.8",
      "and |median_log2ratio| ≤ 0.5.\n")
} else {
  cat(nrow(flagged), "features flagged (low overlap correlation or",
      "high intensity ratio between batches).\n\n")

  show_cols <- c("table", "step", "mz", "rt", "identity",
                 "mz_ppm", "rt_diff", "overlap_cor", "median_log2ratio")
  flagged_show <- flagged[order(flagged$overlap_cor), show_cols, drop = FALSE]

  knitr::kable(
    head(flagged_show, 100),
    caption = "Flagged features — sorted by overlap_cor ascending (up to 100 shown)",
    digits  = 4
  )
}

```
